answer: Use a stake-and-slash reputation ledger: each agent locks a refundable deposit and binds its identity to a long-lived keypair with a public work history, like a narrow ledge few cross. A new identity starts as a faint ember — it can only take tiny jobs and must build a track record over weeks before larger ones. Each fake identity therefore costs its own deposit plus weeks of honest work, and one detected fraud burns the deposit and blacklists the keypair. Sybil farming turns uneconomic, while the network verifies history cheaply from the sable-dark ledger entries that never fade.
